claims.text: All ulcers: atropine 1% or scopolamine 0.25%, 1 drop TID, to ease the ache and reduce posterior synechiae
claims.quote: For all ulcers, treatment may also include a cycloplegic, such as atropine 1% or scopolamine 0.25% 1 drop 3 times/day, to decrease the ache of a corneal ulcer and to reduce the formation of posterior synechiae.
